|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `lod_index` | number | no | LOD index containing the section (default 0) |
| `section_index` | number | no | Index of the section to modify (default 0) |
| `cast_shadow` | boolean | no | New value for the flag (default true) |

**Returns:** `{ lod_index: int, section_index: int, cast_shadow: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_section_recompute_tangent`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the recompute tangent flag on a specific section of a skeletal mesh LOD.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `lod_index` | number | no | LOD index containing the section (default 0) |
| `section_index` | number | no | Index of the section to modify (default 0) |
| `recompute_tangent` | boolean | no | New value for the flag (default true) |

**Returns:** `{ lod_index: int, section_index: int, recompute_tangent: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_section_visible_in_ray_tracing`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Toggle a section's bVisibleInRayTracing flag on a specific skeletal mesh LOD.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `lod_index` | number | no | LOD index containing the section (default 0) |
| `section_index` | number | no | Index of the section to modify (default 0) |
| `b_visible` | boolean | no | New value for the flag (default true) |

**Returns:** `{ lod_index: int, section_index: int, b_visible: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_socket_parent`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Re-parent an existing socket on a skeletal mesh to a different bone. Validates the bone exists in the reference skeleton.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `socket_name` | string | yes | Name of the socket to re-parent |
| `parent_bone_name` | string | yes | Bone name to attach the socket to (must exist in skeleton) |

**Returns:** `{ socket_name: string, parent_bone_name: string, skeletal_mesh_path: string, reparented: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_socket_transform`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the local transform (relative to parent bone) of a socket on a skeletal mesh. All three of location/rotation/scale are optional; only fields present are written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `socket_name` | string | yes | Name of the socket to modify |
| `location` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] relative location |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] relative rotation (degrees) |
| `scale` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] relative scale |

**Returns:** `{ socket_name: string, skeletal_mesh_path: string, applied: {location, rotation, scale}, location_x: float, location_y: float, location_z: float, rotation_pitch: float, rotation_yaw: float, rotation_roll: float, scale_x: float, scale_y: float, scale_z: float }`

## `setup_foot_ik`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Add a Leg IK node (UAnimGraphNode_LegIK) to the top-level AnimGraph of an Animation Blueprint, or reuse the first one already there, bind the feet into its LegsDefinition, then mark the blueprint structurally modified and save it without compiling. Leg 0 gets left_foot_bone and leg 1 right_foot_bone as the FK foot bone; a leg's IK target bone is set to the same bone when it is unset or the leg's foot changes, so the node compiles but has no effect until each IK target names an IK bone (set_anim_graph_node_property on LegsDefinition with the returned node_id); legs beyond the first two and the other leg settings are kept. Bones the target skeleton lacks are an error and nothing is written. The node is left unwired: connect it with connect_anim_graph_pins. Idempotent; refused while PIE runs unless force=true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anim_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Path to the UAnimBlueprint asset. |
| `left_foot_bone` | string | yes | Left foot bone, written as the FK foot bone of leg 0; checked against the target skeleton when the blueprint has one. |
| `right_foot_bone` | string | yes | Right foot bone, written as the FK foot bone of leg 1; checked against the target skeleton when the blueprint has one. |

**Returns:** `{ anim_blueprint_path, node_id, left_foot_bone, right_foot_bone, legs: [{ fk_foot_bone, ik_foot_bone, num_bones_in_limb }], bones_checked_against, ik_node_count, already_existed, saved, save_error }`

## `sort_montage_segments`

*Destructive.*

Sort a montage slot track's segments by start time ascending (FAnimTrack::SortAnimSegments, which then lays them end-to-end and clamps each end time to its animation length) in an undo transaction and save the montage. Segments the sort leaves as they are (already in order, end-to-end and within their animations) are a success with applied=false and saved=false, and the montage is neither modified nor saved. An unknown slot is an error. A failed save makes success false, with saved=false and save_error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `montage_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the montage (e.g. '/Game/MyGame/AM_Example'). |
| `slot_name` | string | yes | Name of the slot track to sort. |

**Returns:** `{ montage_path, slot_name, segment_count, applied, saved, save_error, message }`

## `stop_animation`

*Destructive.*

Stop montage playback on a skeletal mesh component with Montage_Stop and a 0.25 s blend-out: only montage_path when given, otherwise every active montage. Editor world unless the world param says otherwise; an unknown montage_path is an error. was_playing and playing cover any montage.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `component_name` | string | yes | Object name of the USkeletalMeshComponent, e.g. "CharacterMesh0", case-insensitive; the first actor in the world that has one with that name wins |
| `montage_path` | string | no | Full asset path of a specific AnimMontage to stop; if omitted, stops all montages (optional) |
| `world` | string | no | Optional world selector: absent/'editor' (default) \| 'pie' (ambiguous: PlayWorld, else the first PIE context) \| 'server' (the PIE world with authority) \| 'client' \| 'pie:N' \| 'game' (alias of 'pie'). |

**Returns:** `{ component_name: string, was_playing: bool, playing: bool, success: bool, montage_path: string?, montage_name: string?, world: string, world_name: string|null, world_package: string|null, world_type: string|null, net_mode: string|null, pie_instance: number }`

## `validate_anim_state_machine`

*Read-only.*

Check a state machine of an Animation Blueprint by node counts, without compiling or changing it: no states is an error, one an info, several without transitions a warning. state_count counts states only (conduits and aliases excluded), transition_count the transition nodes; compile_anim_blueprint is the check that the machine compiles.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anim_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the UAnimBlueprint |
| `state_machine_name` | string | yes | Name of a state machine in the top-level AnimGraph, matched without case (see list_anim_state_machines). |

**Returns:** `{ is_valid, errors[], warnings[], info[], state_count, transition_count }`

## `wire_aim_offset`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Create a UBlendSpace1D asset for aim-offset blending (yaw or pitch axis). Idempotent on re-run.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `package_path` | string | yes | UE content folder. |
| `asset_name` | string | yes | BlendSpace1D asset name. |
| `skeleton_path` | string | yes | Path to the target USkeleton. |
| `axis_name` | string | no | Optional axis name (default "Yaw"). |
| `min_value` | number | no | Optional float (default -90.0). Axis minimum. |
| `max_value` | number | no | Optional float (default 90.0). Axis maximum. |
| `num_grid_points` | number | no | Optional int (default 4). |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path, axis_name, min_value, max_value, num_grid_points, already_existed, saved }`
